items.title: Cycles of a K-flat acyclic complex with flat terms are flat

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the cycles of a K-flat acyclic complex with flat terms are a flat module (statement lines 3384-3390). The proof tensors the complex with an arbitrary module, keeping acyclicity by K-flatness (proof lines 3392-3405), and then compares the cycles of the tensored complex with the tensor product of the cycles, which by the Tor criterion gives flatness (proof lines 3405-3415). The non-formal content is the identification of the cycles after tensoring. The claim is H2: one comparison plus one criterion.
